query:
SELECT
            d.name AS detection_name,
            ddi.source,
            ddi.confidence,
            ddi.first_seen,
            ddi.last_seen
        FROM indicator i
        JOIN detection_detects_indicator ddi ON ddi.indicator_id = i.id
        JOIN detection d ON d.id = ddi.detection_id
        WHERE i.kind = 'sha256' AND i.value = $1 AND d.kind = 'yara'
